sabines.char_tatius: Titus Tatius, king of the Sabines: a stocky older man with a grey beard, plain bronze helmet, dark blue woollen cloak, heavy round shield on his back

sabines.scene_between_lines: a narrow strip of trampled ground between two facing battle lines seen from the side, spears raised on both edges of the frame, an empty gap in the middle, tense dusty light

lucretia.char_sextus: Sextus Tarquinius, an Etruscan-Roman prince: young man with oiled dark curls, purple-bordered tunic, gold arm ring, a sly arrogant smile, hand on a dagger hilt
lucretia.char_lucretia: Lucretia, a Roman matron: modest white stola with a dark red mantle, hair bound in a simple knot, calm and grave face, holding a spindle
lucretia.char_junius: Lucius Junius Brutus: a Roman nobleman in a plain undyed toga, unkempt dark hair, deliberately blank simpleton's expression that hides sharp eyes, a rod of office in his hand

lucretia.scene_forum_rouse: the early Roman forum crowded with empty speaker's platform: the rostra of rough stone, wooden market stalls shuttered, temple steps behind, torches burning in daylight

mucius.scene_tiber_swim: the broad Tiber at dusk seen from the reedy bank, current dark and fast, an abandoned rope and a wooden stake on the shore, hills beyond
mucius.scene_exile_tent: the cramped tent of an exiled king: a folding stool, a rolled map, a dusty crown resting on a chest, a single lamp, shadows on canvas
mucius.char_scribe_e: an Etruscan royal scribe: a well-dressed clerk in an embroidered robe with gold trim, wax tablets and a stylus in hand, soft self-important face, clearly mistakable for a king at a glance
mucius.scene_brazier_m: an Etruscan king's tent interior: a bronze brazier of glowing coals on a tripod in the centre, a folding throne with a purple cloth behind it, spears of guards leaning at the edges, hot red light, no figures

fabius.scene_open_battle: an open flat Italian plain prepared for pitched battle: churned soil, a dry stream bed, discarded pila, dust hanging in still air
fabius.scene_rescue_field: the edge of a battlefield at evening: a broken ring of shields, standards leaning, a corridor of trampled ground leading out, low golden light
